items.text: Cobalt moves to a new core banking system Saturday, December 12, 00:00 to Sunday, December 13, 12:00 (Central Time). For 36 hours the app is read-only: balances visible, no transfers, no peer-to-peer payments, no new cards. Card payments work offline up to $100 per payment. The switch may run some hours longer.
